_about: THE FEED (FEED lane 23, row [the feed is alive], Paolo 10/26 rule 215: 'a part of the game managing all these mini events and triggers, presented in a social media thing, to make it feel alive... pretty much tweets... organize it properly so every time we upgrade it gets better, realistic vibes'). ONE FILE, every post the phone's FEED app shows comes from a row here. The engine (engine/bohemia_feedstream.js, engine()) knows no sentence and no account: a new kind is a new row, a new voice is a new account, never code. Rule 217 (10/26): a post is a USERNAME and its words, no portrait for now; every account keeps an empty face field for later. Every line is draft:true; WORDS writes and sharpens them (WORDS [the feed's words], [the usernames tell the story]). Spanglish comes from the house dial (engine/bohemia_spanglish.js, rule 143(a), 10 to 15 percent), never written in by hand for a line that has a plain English twin; the company's page is the player's voice and is never Spanglish (rule 27); bots never roll.
_how_to_add: A KIND: {id (letters, digits, underscores), source (mine = what you did, world = what the world did, life = the city's own life), trigger (an event name the game fires, see _triggers, or 'quiet' for the city's life when nothing has happened for a while), who (account ids, 'tag:<tag>', 'faction' = the event's faction's page, 'town' = an account from the event's town), when (hours [from,to), night, act, min_day, is {key: value}, at_least {key: n}, below {key: n}), chance (0 to 1, a non-deed kind only), must (a deed waits for room and is never dropped; true by default for source mine), big (more posts allowed for a while after, and replies come), max_per_hour, cooldown_min, delay_min [lo,hi] (how soon after the event, game minutes), again_key + again_after_min (the same key does not post again inside that many minutes), words (variants; {key} comes from the event, a variant whose key the event lacks is skipped), replies [{who, chance, delay_min, words}] ({parent_handle} is the post answered), follow_up [{who ('same' = the same account), chance, after_min, words}], teaches (what a stranger learns from it)}. AN ACCOUNT: {id, handle, kind (local, bot, faction, company, stranger), tags, faction (a factions.json id), town, lang (es or spanglish leans to the dial's high side, en low; omit for the dial's own roll), acts {'2': handle in act two, '3': ...}, face ('' until a face exists, rule 217(a)), story (what the handle tells, for WORDS)}. A modder adds rows; the game reads this file at boot.

_triggers.quiet: the city's own life, when nothing else has posted for a while; every event above also carries {company, day, hour, hh, night, act} and the game's {town} when it has one
_triggers.scarce.down: {key, now, was} (days of a good left in the valley's market)

pace._why: A real local feed: a handful of posts in a stretch of the day, more after something big, never a wall. MEASURED 10/26 on the demo's map: an in-game hour passes in 2.3 s of travel on dirt and 4.6 s on a road (10.75 game minutes a block, 1.22 blocks a beat), and the clock stops in towns, fights and when he stands still. So the window is four game hours, not one (a handful an hour would be two posts a second while he travels), and real_gap_s keeps one post on the glass long enough to read it. WORDS Q15 measured 30 neighbourhood feeds: about 1.4 replies a post, and the most common post is somebody asking for something.
